exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs Vaginal delivery)
outcome: Maternal outcomes (PPH, bladder injury, maternal death)
cohort: Women who underwent peripartum hysterectomy at a tertiary care teaching hospital from January 2017 to December 2019 (n=50)
finding: The incidence of peripartum hysterectomy was 1.3 per 1,000 deliveries and was more common following caesarean sections (3.5/1,000) than vaginal deliveries (OR 22.86).
mod_finding: Peripartum hysterectomy was found to be more common following cesarean sections than vaginal deliveries (odds ratio 22.86 [95% CI: 8.16 to 63.98]).
